transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, this is an AI assistant calling from your care team. May I please ask if I am speaking with Rahul?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Rahul, I have your health results here to share with you. Your fasting blood glucose reading from October first, two thousand twenty-six was one hundred eighty milligrams per deciliter. Do you have any questions about that?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I understand. I would like to see a doctor to discuss this further.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Before we book, I want to share your second result. Your HbA1c reading from October first, two thousand twenty-six was eight point two percent. Do you have any questions about this result?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I’d like to see a doctor to discuss these results. Please schedule an appointment for me.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A doctor can review these results with you and help answer any questions you have. Do you have a preference for morning, afternoon, or no preference for the consultation time?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: There are no available slots in the afternoon at the moment. Would you like the care team to call you back to schedule the appointment at a later time?
